approval_required_for: Bounded human approval is required only if provenance recovery remains ambiguous between remote infrastructure, stale hierarchy metadata, report-schema failure, and exact identity-binding failure; no source or evidence-binding change may be guessed from ambiguity.

consumes: current exact board identity document and source hashes
current exact Vivado export facts and compile contexts
executable_actions.on_failure: If the capability cannot preserve a real command/launch record or conclusively classifies the event as source-independent infrastructure, retain the board layer as blocked, preserve all active contamination barriers and retries, request bounded approval for ambiguous infrastructure recovery, and do not edit RTL, wrapper, monitor, testbench, manifest, checkpoint, stimulus, numeric policy, tolerance, or run an unchanged-source VCS replay. If it instead provides a source-attributed or exact identity-binding diagnosis, return that hash-bound record to a new Stage8 causal-repair decision; rerun case_axi_ddr_interface before any VCS functional simulation and reopen a lower layer only if a later current trace directly contradicts its certificate.
executable_actions.rationale: The required diagnostic capability is absent: the available run stopped in remote stage pruning and does not preserve enough provenance to distinguish source-independent cleanup/transport failure, stale or absent hierarchy metadata, identity-binding failure, report-schema failure, or a source-attributed VCS compile/elaboration failure. Implementing this read-only capability is required before any source, manifest, testbench, monitor, or replay decision; it must use the exact current user-supplied board project facts and must not guess targets or simulator commands.

observations: real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface failed before functional simulation because simulation.source_identity_sha256, compile_authority, ordered-command authority_refs, and simulator executable authorization do not bind the current exact board identity, Vivado export facts, and tool profile.

The prior repair execution records compile returncode=125, remote_state=not_run, and simulation status=not_run after remote stage pruning. The only reported hierarchy error has no source path, line, declaration context, compile order, or source-attributed VCS diagnostic; it explicitly does not authorize a source-semantic repair.

contract_guided_debug_closure classifies the failure as verification_capability_gap, has no failed boundary and no localized transaction trace, and explicitly blocks hardware boundary tracing until semantic/verifier capability is repaired.

The live hash-bound operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates remain reusable. No current board trace supplies direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and certificate contradiction evidence, so neither lower layer may be reopened.

Connected-kernel timing knowledge remains binding if later needed: it is an elastic variable-latency token pipeline requiring boundary order and cross-token overlap, not same-cycle completion across unequal-latency stages.

The missing board semantic-evidence report is a downstream consequence of blocked required tools, not independent evidence of a hardware or weight-consumption defect. There is presently no board-level target-model numeric comparison, complete DUT weight-consumption proof, AXI/DDR protocol result, lifecycle-frontier result, or output evidence.

sacg_memory_truth reports 16 active in-scope contamination barriers, including barriers.0329 through .0353, and six open in-scope retry requests (retry_request.0136, .0140, .0141, .0142, .0143, .0144). Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only and cannot support promotion. There is no scoped open backtrack request.
The conditional design-team router returned no_split; no specialist review was triggered, and its absence cannot replace deterministic current-layer evidence.
proposed_actions: Implement and run only a read-only VCS compile-diagnostic provenance recovery capability for the current exact board identity, Vivado export, tool profile, remote-pruning record, and existing hierarchy report.

Use the recovery classification to make the next bounded decision: source-independent remote/pruning or report-schema failure remains an infrastructure/capability blocker requiring bounded approval; an identity-binding classification may authorize a fresh evidence-bound harness/manifest repair plan; a source-attributed diagnostic may authorize a new causal-slice repair plan. Do not apply any branch before the classification is produced.

Keep lower-layer certificates closed and preserve all immutable semantic-verification inputs. After any later authorized repair, rerun case_axi_ddr_interface first; only after it passes may the current-layer VCS functional and targeted boundary-trace flow run.
risks: Changing RTL or a lower-layer kernel based on this failure would violate the three-layer repair loop and could destroy certified leaf/kernel evidence without a contradictory trace.

Changing a board manifest, wrapper, monitor, testbench, checkpoint, stimulus, reference output, numeric comparison policy, or tolerance before diagnostic attribution would mask an infrastructure or identity-binding failure and violates the prior repair-execution restriction.

An arbitrary simulator executable, inferred wrapper name, simplified AXI/DDR shell, stale Vivado export, or unbound source hash could make a subsequent run non-board-accurate even if it appears to compile.

Until an independent target-model reference for the immutable checkpoint and same stimulus is bound to a real board-wrapped DUT execution with complete required Transformer-block weight-consumption evidence, no functional correctness claim is possible.
Independent prefetch or AXI activity, if observed later, is not output/lifecycle-frontier progress and cannot by itself imply liveness or reopen the certified connected kernel.
The active contamination barriers and open retries block downstream consumption and promotion until a newly produced, hash-bound Stage7 candidate passes all current board-layer gates.

constraints: current exact user-supplied board wrapper and Vivado-export source identity must be hash-bound
compile authority and each ordered simulator command must be authorized by the current tool profile and cited Vivado export
target-model reference, checkpoint, stimulus, numeric policy, tolerance, semantic testbench contract, and board-wrapper hashes remain immutable during repair
no lower-layer reopening without a current hash-bound board trace directly contradicting a named certified invariant
active SACG contamination barriers prevent downstream use or promotion of rejected artifacts

output.summary: Fail-closed current-layer decision: board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system cannot promote to backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI release, or board runtime. The earliest executable failure is the board simulation identity/compile-authority contract at case_axi_ddr_interface; VCS functional simulation and all downstream functional, AXI, DDR, liveness, numeric, data-order, weight-consumption, and semantic-evidence gates are dependency-blocked. The only authorized next intervention is read-only recovery of missing VCS/remote-pruning diagnostic provenance. No RTL, wrapper, monitor, testbench, manifest, numeric-policy, checkpoint, stimulus, or tolerance change, and no unchanged-source replay, is authorized by the present evidence.
